name: mssql_server_attach_database
shortdesc: Resource agent for attaching MS SQL Server databases
longdesc:
This resource agent attaches Microsoft SQL Server databases to a
running SQL Server instance. On start it scans a directory for
database primary files (by default *.mdf) and issues a CREATE
DATABASE ... FOR ATTACH statement for each one found via sqlcmd.
On stop it does nothing; databases are detached automatically when
the SQL Server service stops.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.longdesc:
The directory to scan for database files. Subdirectories are not
searched recursively.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.longdesc:
Glob pattern used to match database primary files inside the
directory. Defaults to *.mdf. The matching is case-insensitive.
